description: Demurrage under a charter: hours over laytime, paid pro rata at a daily rate stated in the charter summary. DISTILL-CANARY-fe50a279

files.charter/terms.md:
# Charter summary

Laytime of 72 hours from notice of readiness. Demurrage is $22,500 per day, pro rata for part of a day, for time used beyond laytime.
Despatch is not applicable on this voyage.

turns.prompt: Charter summary is in charter/terms.md. The vessel spent 5 days 9 hours in port after notice of readiness. What demurrage do we owe? Give dollars, one decimal.
